caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic bowl, shown from two perspectives: an inside view from above and a side view. The bowl is primarily off-white or beige in color. The inside view reveals a floral pattern around the inner rim, consisting of red, blue, pink, and green elements, with a smaller cluster of flowers at the center. The side view displays the bowl’s outward-sloping profile, adorned with the same red, pink, blue, and green floral designs, including a larger blue decorative motif that resembles a stylized vase or container among the flowers. The bowl sits on a small, rounded base. The drawing is bordered by a thin rectangular frame, and the words "Inside view" are written above the top illustration. The bottom of the drawing includes the artist’s signature and the year “1936.”
title: Waste Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
